User.title: User
User.description: User profile with role-based access for CampTrack AWAZEL CO. system

userId.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user

displayName.description: User full name or display name

role.description: Authorization level: ADMIN (Full authorization) or VIEW_ONLY (View only)

AdminMarker.title: AdminMarker
AdminMarker.description: Marker document in admins collection for zero-cost rules check

userId.description: User UID who has administrative authorization

createdAt.description: Timestamp when admin status was granted

CampRoom.title: CampRoom
CampRoom.description: Camp room accommodation unit with 2-bed capacity

roomNumber.description: Room identifier, e.g., A-1, A-2, B-1, B-2

block.description: Camp block, e.g., Block A, Block B, Block C, Block D

capacity.description: Maximum bed capacity, strictly 2 beds per room

note.description: Optional notes or maintenance remarks for the room

Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Camp resident employee allotment and residency record

roomNumber.description: Assigned room number or empty/omitted if checked out

bedNumber.description: Assigned bed number (1 for Bed 1, 2 for Bed 2) or omitted if checked out

company.description: Company name, defaulting to AWAZEL CO.

status.description: Resident status: ACTIVE, ON_VACATION, or CHECKED_OUT

notes.description: Additional remarks or room inspection comments

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of system user profiles with authorization roles

/admins/{userId}.description: Collection of admin marker documents for role checking

/employees/{employeeId}.description: Collection of resident employees and allotments
